import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CartierKernelStalkLength
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.WeilDivisor

/-!
# Ambient principal equations for divisor charts

A local Cartier equation defines a rational function on the ambient integral
curve. Its order on the chart is the length of the actual divisor quotient
stalk. This identifies the associated effective Weil divisor with a principal
divisor locally, retaining the original equation for the ideal comparison.

This is the curve specialization of Kleiman, *The Picard scheme*, Section 3,
`sb:ediv`, used in the divisor-to-Grassmannian construction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierKernel

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U]
variable {E F : (U : Scheme).Modules} (q : E ⟶ F)
variable (eO : E ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
variable (eI : kernel q ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The ambient rational function defined by a chart's Cartier equation. -/
noncomputable def ambientLocalEquationUnit : X.functionFieldˣ :=
  Units.mk0 ((X.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) (genericPoint X)
    (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (by simpa using U.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance))).hom
      (localEquation q eO eI)) (by
    intro h
    apply localEquation_ne_zero q eO eI
    apply germ_injective_of_isIntegral X (U := U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) (genericPoint X)
      (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (by simpa using U.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance))
    exact h.trans (map_zero _).symm)

/-- The ambient equation is exactly the generic germ of the original chart section. -/
theorem ambientLocalEquationUnit_val :
    (ambientLocalEquationUnit U q eO eI : X.functionField) =
      (X.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) (genericPoint X)
        (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty
          (by simpa using U.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance))).hom
        (localEquation q eO eI) := rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The order of the ambient chart equation equals the intrinsic quotient length. -/
theorem ordZ_ambientLocalEquationUnit_eq_stalkLength
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 p] [Epi q] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (z : U) (hz : z.val ≠ genericPoint X) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (ordZ p hz (ambientLocalEquationUnit U q eO eI)) =
      ((Modules.stalkLength F z).toNat : ℤ) := by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian p
  letI := isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk p hz
  letI := isDedekindDomain_stalk p hz
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hzV, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := U.toScheme) (x := z) (U := ⊤) trivial
  have hlen := stalkLength_eq_ord q eO eI V hV ⟨z, hzV⟩
  have hgerm := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (localEquation q eO eI))
    (U.germ_stalkIso_hom z (V := ⊤) trivial)
  have hlen' : Modules.stalkLength F z = Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk z.val)
      (X.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) z.val ⟨z, trivial, rfl⟩
        (localEquation q eO eI)) := by
    rw [hlen, Ring.ord_ringEquiv (U.stalkIso z).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv]
    exact congrArg (Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk z.val)) hgerm
  have ha : X.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) z.val ⟨z, trivial, rfl⟩
      (localEquation q eO eI) ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha
    apply localEquation_ne_zero q eO eI
    apply germ_injective_of_isIntegral X (U := U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) z.val ⟨z, trivial, rfl⟩
    exact ha.trans (map_zero _).symm
  have hreg := mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
  have hfinite : Modules.stalkLength F z ≠ ⊤ :=
    hlen'.trans_ne (Ring.ord_ne_top hreg)
  rw [ordZ_toAdd_eq_log_ordFrac p]
  change WithZero.log (Ring.ordFrac (X.presheaf.stalk z.val)
    ((ambientLocalEquationUnit U q eO eI : X.functionField))) = _
  rw [ambientLocalEquationUnit_val,
    germ_generic_eq_algebraMap_germ (X := X) (x := z.val)
      (U := U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) _ ⟨z, trivial, rfl⟩,
    Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord (X.presheaf.stalk z.val) ha,
    Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_coe (X.presheaf.stalk z.val) hreg
      (hlen'.symm.trans (ENat.coe_toNat hfinite).symm)]
  rfl

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierKernel

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S}

local instance : IsIntegral (pullback π s) := fieldTest_isIntegral (π := π) (s := s)

local instance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (pullback.snd π s) :=
  fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)

local instance (U : (pullback π s).Opens) :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (U.ι ≫ pullback.snd π s) :=
  IsZariskiLocalAtSource.comp (fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)) U.ι

/-- The actual divisor chart equation as a rational function on the entire fibre. -/
noncomputable def chartEquationUnit (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (U : (pullback π s).Opens) [Nonempty U]
    (e : kernel (chartQuotient x U) ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf) :
    (pullback π s : Scheme).functionFieldˣ :=
  CartierKernel.ambientLocalEquationUnit U (chartQuotient x U) (Iso.refl _) e

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Every actual divisor chart principalizes its associated Weil divisor. -/
theorem coeffAt_divOf_chartEquationUnit (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (U : (pullback π s).Opens) [Nonempty U]
    (e : kernel (chartQuotient x U) ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
    (z : (pullback π s : Scheme)) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme))
    (hzU : z ∈ U) :
    coeffAt hz (divOf (pullback.snd π s) (chartEquationUnit x U e)) =
      coeffAt hz x.effectiveWeilDivisor := by
  letI : x.F.IsFinitePresentation := x.isFinitePresentation
  letI : ((Modules.pullback U.ι).obj x.F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    Modules.pullback_isFinitePresentation U.ι x.F inferInstance
  letI : Epi (chartQuotient x U) := chartQuotient_epi x U
  change Multiplicative.toAdd
      (ordZ (pullback.snd π s) hz (chartEquationUnit x U e)) =
    toFinsupp x.effectiveWeilDivisor ⟨z, hz⟩
  rw [effectiveWeilDivisor_apply_eq_chart_order x U e ⟨z, hzU⟩ hz,
    CartierKernel.ordZ_localEquationUnit_eq_stalkLength]
  exact CartierKernel.ordZ_ambientLocalEquationUnit_eq_stalkLength U
    (chartQuotient x U) (Iso.refl _) e (pullback.snd π s) ⟨z, hzU⟩ hz

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily
